name: print-social-blogging-stats-poster-with-world-map-and-camera-crew
title: 'Blogging' infographic with a central world-map ring chart, age-group bars and camera-crew illustrations
whatItIs: A teal-and-white infographic centred on a 'BLOGGING' banner, with a world-outline ring chart split by category (Beauty, Fashion, Travel, Talking, Cooking) at its centre, flanking illustrations of bloggers filming and vlogging, age-group percentage bars (14–18, 18–26, >26), a Trends donut chart, a Statistics panel with heart/comment/follower icons and bar charts, and a growth line chart at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Busy but anchored; centring everything around one ring chart keeps a stat-heavy poster from feeling scattered.
techniques: Anchor an infographic around one central ring or donut chart.
Illustrate the subject (bloggers) alongside their own statistics.
Repeat a two-colour palette across every chart type for cohesion.

vocabulary.definition: A circular chart, similar to a donut chart, split into proportional segments.
A chart showing a value's change over time.
